item.title: Tibiofemoral Traction
patientPosition: Sitting with knee flexed or supine depending on technique.
contact: Grasp proximal/distal tibia securely without compressing fibular nerve.
steps: 4. Use Grade III only for stiffness when appropriate.
mistakes: Pulling from ankle without controlling knee.
safety: Avoid DVT, unstable ligament injury, fracture.
item.visualCue: Femur fixed → Tibia distracted longitudinally → Re-test knee pain/ROM.

subTechniques.name: Tibiofemoral Traction
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Reduce compression sensitivity or stretch the capsule according to the traction grade.
subTechniques.patientSetup: Sitting or supine with the knee positioned so the joint is relaxed.
subTechniques.contact: Stabilize the femur and grasp the proximal tibia/leg securely without compressing the fibular head.
subTechniques.direction: Apply sustained distraction perpendicular to the tibial treatment plane.
subTechniques.clinicalPearl: Grade choice should match irritability; a stiff joint does not automatically require a high-grade stretch.
subTechniques.safetyNote: Avoid acute instability, fracture or DVT.
